basis: Schneider’s Q1 2023 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its consolidated income statement reported operating revenues of $1,428.7 million for the three months ended March 31, 2023, against $1,620.5 million a year earlier. The 95% cutoff was $1,539.475 million. Reported revenue fell 11.84% year over year. Both figures include fuel surcharges and reflect intersegment eliminations.

coverage.detail: October 27, 2022, preceding earnings cycle. The Q3 release forecast full-year 2022 adjusted diluted EPS of $2.60–$2.65 and net capital expenditures of $475 million. It gave no Q1 2023 consolidated revenue range.
On the October 27 call, management discussed freight demand, a muted peak season and strategic plans heading into 2023. It supplied no numeric ceiling for Q1 2023 consolidated revenue.

February 2, 2023, immediately preceding earnings release. Management expected demand to strengthen during 2023. Its numeric outlook covered full-year adjusted diluted EPS of $2.15–$2.35, net capital expenditures of $525–$575 million and an effective tax rate of approximately 24.5%. There was no Q1 sales forecast.
Slide 26 of the Q4 investor presentation showed the same full-year EPS and capital expenditure ranges. Neither established a quarterly revenue bound.

On the February 2 call, the CFO said Q1 2023 could be the year’s softest point. That described the expected timing of improvement without quantifying Q1 consolidated sales or their year-over-year change.
Schneider’s January 25 announcement identified two intervening public fireside chats, Evercore on February 8 and Raymond James on March 7. The announcement gave no Q1 forecast.

February 8 management remarks, checked in a third-party transcript. The CEO discussed sequential freight seasonality. The 5% volume decline concerned Q4 Power Only activity, and the 5%–7% target concerned Logistics margin. Neither quantified Q1 consolidated revenue.

The 2022 annual report described Q1 seasonality without a Q1 2023 sales bound. It also documented the June 2022 deBoer acquisition and November 2022 sale of China logistics operations. The April release supplied both reported comparative figures directly, with no pro forma adjustment needed.

March 7 management remarks, checked in a third-party transcript. The CEO’s 95% figure compared Q4 2022 Power Only volume with Q4 2021. Other figures concerned spot rates, segment margins and intermodal revenue per order. No Q1 consolidated revenue ceiling was given.
March 30 issuer notice scheduled the Q1 results for April 27 before market open. It contained no preliminary sales figure.
The April 26 Form 8-K covered shareholder voting and the quarterly dividend. It supplied no preliminary Q1 revenue.

April 27 issuer release. The consolidated operating revenue line shows $1,428.7 million versus $1,620.5 million. The separate fuel-surcharge-excluded line shows $1,249.5 million versus $1,454.5 million.

publication_date_evidence: Schneider’s investor-relations results page is dated April 27, 2023. The SEC-hosted earnings release carries the same April 27 dateline and says Schneider announced results that day for the three months ended March 31, 2023.
